title: Kingston to Cromer: Westspur, Weyburn and Saskatchewan Gathering
dek: One Winnipeg family group gathers SE Saskatchewan and SW Manitoba crude to a single commingling point. Kingston's Westspur trunk delivers Southeastern Saskatchewan crude (SES) into the Light Sour Blend pool and batched Westspur Midale (MSM) into the Midale pool at Cromer, and Kingston Marketing blends liquid butane into both streams at the Manitoba Interconnect on the way in. Westspur ran 152 kb/d in 2025 against approx 247 kb/d of capacity; the growth leg is Midale, not LSB.
